title: DC Twin
description: Builds 3D data-center digital twins from data, not code: DTDL v3 models, generated layouts and a theme compile into one self-contained Three.js page. The models cover racks, power and network paths, sensors and events. v0.1.0 shipped a CLI (init, generate, validate, build), a schema validator and two example twins; since then it has gained a DCIM CSV importer, a thermal overlay and an MCP server so an agent can build and edit a twin. Telemetry comes from a seeded mock feed; no live data feed yet.
